messages:
priya: Quick sync — we need to lock the on-prem deployment acceptance playbook for the Private Q3 rollout. Customers want deterministic egress IP, KMS/HSM keywrap, and optional BGP. Can we sketch must-have acceptance criteria and a minimal test plan?

samir: +1. Initial must-haves from my side: stable egress IP across agent restarts, control-plane TLS with customer certs, KMS integration smoke. Also define latency and error-rate SLOs.

maya: For egress we should support two modes: customer-managed NAT and provider-provided NAT. Edge case to call out: dual-stack / IPv6-only customer env — need fallback behavior.

jonathan: BGP should be opt-in alpha. Requirements: ASN exchange, route filtering, RPKI/route validation guidance, and a safety net to avoid accidental full-route leaks. Canary plan: single customer in staging, limited prefixes.

alice: Ops/runbook items: rollback-to-hosted route, cert-rotation steps, fail-open vs fail-closed policy documented. Test snippet for basic health: ```curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://private.CUSTOMER/healthz || exit 1
dig @1.1.1.1 example.internal A```

ops_lead: Add an "evacuate compute" procedure (move workloads off GPUs) and a certificate revocation drill. Who owns the runbook maintenance after GA?

priya: Product will own the playbook and hand off runbook ownership to oncall after 90 days. Acceptance checklist draft: infra-as-code templates present, canary customer deployed in staging, documented rollback plan, smoke CI passing.

jonathan: Edge-case: customer behind symmetric NAT — connection pinning and KV-cache warmup can be impacted. Add a metric: "tail latency by connection TTL" to detect this.

samir: QA test list proposal: 1) control-plane restart x3 and egress validation, 2) simulate network flaps (packet loss, route churn), 3) KMS key-rotate while in-flight, 4) tests for IPv6-only environment. Can we add an automated smoke job in staging CI to run these nightly?

maya: Also regulatory note: audit logs must be redacted for PII. Add a log-redaction acceptance test and a sample log-scrubbed payload.

devrel-bot: Draft PRD link: https://redwood.docs/private/onprem-playbook-draft — please review the acceptance criteria section. :eyes:

priya: OK I'll update the PRD with these points and add a short prioritization matrix (must-have / should-have / nice-to-have). Drop any additional items by EOD. If no blockers, we'll mark this "ready for RFC" tomorrow. :thumbsup:
